description: Boundary coverage for deriving the collector's effective exclusion rules by appending the two built-in internal exclusions (the internal prelude pseudo-file and the schema definition file) to the user-configured ignore list while preserving order. Exercises an empty ignore list, several user rules including a regex extension pattern, and a single non-default rule.

cases.expected_output:
count=5
rule=vendor
rule=node_modules
rule=.erb$
rule=internal:prelude
rule=schema.rb
